description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding to be used as a garage, storage and gym room with creation of a gateway to the garden following demolition of existing detached garage
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Site location plan; block and location plan; existing floor and roof plans; existing sections and elevations; proposed floor and roof plans; proposed elevations; proposed sections; existing and proposed tree locations (received on 15 November 2019) ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those incidental to the application property and shall not be used as primary accommodation such as a living room, bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, study or as a separate unit of accommodation.
